libraries.name: AutomationDirect DIN-rail relays
libraries.description: Relays, timers, monitoring relays and relay sockets for 35 mm DIN rail sold by AutomationDirect: Murrelektronik, Klemsan, Dold, Gefran, Macromatic, Fuji and AutomationDirect sockets.

libraries.name: Phoenix Contact UT terminal blocks
libraries.description: UT screw terminal blocks from 1.5 to 35 mm²: feed-through, ground, TWIN and QUATTRO, double- and three-level, fuse and disconnect blocks, with their end covers, partition and spacer plates, and end clamps.

libraries.name: Amphenol 26482 Series 2 connectors
libraries.description: MIL-DTL-26482 Series 2 circular receptacles (MS3470, MS3471, MS3474): all 34 insert arrangements, shell sizes 8 to 24, in pin and socket versions, with contacts placed as seen from the wire side.

libraries.name: AutomationDirect pushbuttons & pilot lights
libraries.description: 22 mm GCX pushbuttons, selector switches, E-stops and pilot lights, Fuji Command and Eaton HT800 30 mm devices, and Schmersal N (22 mm) and E (30 mm) devices with their EF contact and light blocks and NK-T/RK-T joysticks, one type per contact arrangement, drawn from the wiring side.

libraries.name: Misc networking
libraries.description: Tripp Lite NGI-U05E industrial 5-port switch and NPOEI-60W-1G PoE++ injector for DIN rail, the StarTech IH2006 HDMI KVM-over-IP transmitter and receiver, and an ASUS computer with six serial ports.
